I don’t want every person
Who loves me
To become another room

I tear apart

[Choir]
No more!

[Lead]
Just to keep the lights on

[Choir]
No more!

[Lead]
I want to learn
How to sit in the dark

Without setting fire
To everyone

[Soft Vocal]
Maybe one day
Love can enter

And stay

Maybe one day
I won’t need
Everybody

To prove
I’m okay

[🔋 Tiny power-down tone]

[Whispered]
Low charge.

title: Drowning in the light
lyrics:
[Intro 🌌 - Distant ambient piano, tape hiss, slow swell]

[Verse 1 🌧️ - Fragile, close whisper, intimate delivery]
Cold glass against my palm...
The sunrise bleeds across the dawn...
(Such a golden view)
My feet are anchored to the floor
Watching shadows walk right out the door
I see the sky wide open...
...but I can’t move.

[Pre-Chorus ⏳ - Building tension, layered harmonies, subtle sub-bass]
The current is pulling me deep—
(Down, down, into the dark)
Yet somehow my spirit still leaps—
(A tiny, stubborn spark)
I reach for the surface...
Can you hear me?
Can you feel it?

[Chorus 🔥 - Explosive, soaring, anthemic belting]
I am DROWNING in the light!
Held down, but reaching for the height!
Nothing I do will change this tide—
(Nothing changes, nothing moves)
YET I STILL BELIEVE WE WILL SURVIVE!
Oh, I am helpless—
(So helpless!)
—BUT HOPE IS ON FIRE!

[Verse 2 🌧️ - Stripped back, breathless, delicate]
Dust motes dancing in a beam of gold.
Every heavy secret that I hold...
(Let it slip away)
A parachute that will not spread,
With clear blue skies above my head.
I’m falling...
...and it’s beautiful.

[Pre-Chorus ⏳ - Faster tempo push, racing heartbeat percussion]
The ground is rushing near—
(Don't look, don't look)
I’m drowning out the fear—
(The breath I took)
Hands open wide...
Ready for the turn!

[Chorus 🔥 - Massive wall of sound, intense vocal distortion, full choir]
I am DROWNING in the light!
Held down, but reaching for the height!
Nothing I do will change this tide—
(Nothing changes, nothing moves)
YET I STILL BELIEVE WE WILL SURVIVE!
Oh, I am helpless—
(So helpless!)
—BUT HOPE IS ON FIRE!

[Bridge ⚡ - Stuttering rhythm, intense spoken-word building to a raw scream]
[Stop]
Can’t stop the river.
(Can’t stop the rain.)
Can’t fix the broken.
(Can’t wash the pain.)
[Drum Crescendo]
I have NO CONTROL—
...and that is where I fly!
LOOK AT THE SKY!

[Guitar Solo 🎸 - Soaring, emotional, melodic shoegaze lead]

[Final Chorus 🔥✨ - Ultimate emotional peak, ad-libs, cathartic belting]
I AM DROWNING IN THE LIGHT!
(Drowning, drowning!)
Paralyzed, but taking flight!
The world is crashing at my feet—
YET THIS HEART REFUSES TO DEFEAT!
Helpless in the storm...
(So warm!)
HOPE IS STILL ALIVE!

[Outro 🌌 - Reverb tail, acoustic piano, fading whisper]
Just drifting now...
(Hopeful...)
...and powerless.
(Let it fall.)
...
[Fade Out 🕊️]
[End]

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I packed a box in the hall
Kept my keys by the bowl
One old coat on the chair
And a bag with a broken zipper hole

The floor knows my feet
The walls know my name
But I’m done standing still
In the middle of the same old frame

[Pre-Chorus]
If the door swings open
I’m already halfway there
You can call it running
I call it getting air

[Chorus]
Bag by the door
I can leave now
Bag by the door
I can breathe now
One more zip, one more choice
I hear a new life call my voice
Bag by the door
I can leave now

[Verse 2]
Got a tote from the store
Got a duffel from June
Got a backpack for nights
And a case for a better tune

Every handle I hold
Feels like a train-line spark
Every pocket says go
Every strap points past the dark

[Pre-Chorus]
If the door swings open
I’m already halfway there

[Chorus]
Bag by the door
I can leave now
Bag by the door
I can breathe now

I hear a new life call my voice

Not because I’m lost

title: Don’t Press the Burger
lyrics:
[Intro: grill sizzling, funky bass riff]

[Spoken]
First rule of burgers…

[Pause]

Stop touching the meat.

[Drum hit]

[Verse 1: bouncing groove]

Get that eighty-twenty beef
Fat brings flavor
That’s the belief

Six ounces
Nice and loose
Don’t knead the life
Out of the juice

Shape it wider
Than the bun
Little dimple
Center one

Straight in the fridge
Till the skillet’s hot

[Backing Vocals]
HOT! HOT! HOT!

[Lead]
Cast iron screaming
That’s the spot

[Pre-Chorus]

Salt and pepper
Right before

Season both sides
Nothing more

No breadcrumbs
No egg inside

This ain’t meatloaf
Let the beef provide

[Chorus: crunchy guitars]

DON’T PRESS THE BURGER!
LET THE JUICES STAY

HARD SEAR FIRST
THEN FLIP AWAY

Three or four minutes
First side down
Deep brown crust
All around

Flip it once
Cheese goes on

[Backing Vocals]
Cover that pan!

[Lead]
Let it melt
Then move along

[Verse 2]

Toast those buns
Cut-side low
Butter if you want
Let ’em glow

Pickles ready
Onions sliced
Tomato salted
Very nice

Sauce could be
Mayo and mustard

Ketchup too
If that’s your custom

[Backing Vocals]
Build it!
Stack it!

[Lead]
But don’t bury
All the beef

[Bridge: beat drops, spoken rhythm]

For food safety
Ground beef should reach
One-sixty Fahrenheit

Check the middle!

[Lead]
Use a thermometer
Not your hopes and dreams

And once it’s done
Let it rest
Just a minute or two

Because patience
Is technically
An ingredient too

[Final Chorus: bigger]

DON’T PRESS THE BURGER!
LET THE JUICES STAY

HARD SEAR FIRST
THEN FLIP AWAY

Toast the bun
Melt the cheese
Pickles
Onions
Sauce with ease

Keep it simple
Keep it bold

Juicy center
Crust like gold

BEEF!
SALT!
HEAT!
REST!

[Lead]
That’s the burger
That’s the test

[Outro: grill sizzle fading]

[Spoken]
Eighty-twenty.

Hot pan.

One flip.

Don’t press it.

[Pause]

Unless you’re making smash burgers.

[Backing Vocals]
Different song!

[Final guitar hit]

title: SALMON AT SEVEN
lyrics:
[Intro: kitchen percussion, chopping rhythm]

[Spoken]
All right.
Dinner in twenty minutes.
No drama.

[Verse 1]

Take that salmon
Pat it dry
Set it on the board
Skin-side nearby

Little olive oil
Salt goes down
Black pepper falling
All around

Garlic powder
Paprika too
Maybe some lemon zest
If that’s your move

[Backing Vocals]
Season it!
Season it!

[Lead]
Don’t drown the fish
Just make it sing

[Pre-Chorus]

Heat the oven
Four-two-five
Give that fillet
Room to thrive

Line the tray
Set it down
Now we’re getting
Dinner-bound

[Chorus]

SALMON AT FOUR-TWENTY-FIVE
TWELVE TO FIFTEEN
KEEP IT ALIVE

LEMON ON TOP
BUTTER IF YOU PLEASE
FLAKE WITH A FORK
AND SERVE WITH EASE

Don’t cook it dry
Don’t let it fight
Pull it when the center
Looks just right

[Verse 2]

While it cooks
Make something bright

Rice or potatoes
Greens on the side

Broccoli roasting
Right beside
Little salt
Little oil
Let it ride

Mix some butter
Garlic
Lemon juice

Parsley if you’ve got it
No excuse

[Backing Vocals]
Whisk it!
Drizzle it!

[Lead]
Now we’re getting somewhere

[Bridge: beat drops, spoken rhythm]

Check the thickest part

Opaque on the outside
Moist in the middle

If you use a thermometer
One-forty-five Fahrenheit
Is the USDA-safe target

[Backing Vocals]
Don’t guess!
Don’t stress!

[Lead]
And remember
Carryover heat
Is real

[Final Chorus]

SALMON AT FOUR-TWENTY-FIVE
TWELVE TO FIFTEEN
KEEP IT ALIVE

LEMON ON TOP
BUTTER IF YOU PLEASE
GARLIC AND HERBS
AND SOMETHING GREEN

Rest it a minute
Plate it up clean

Dinner just happened
Like a beautiful dream

[Outro: light guitar, plate clink]

[Spoken]
Salmon.
Lemon.
Garlic.
Butter.

That’s dinner.

[Final hit]

title: WHERE DOES CONFIDENCE END?
lyrics:
[Intro: lone piano, slow handclaps]

[Spoken]
I know what I want.

[Pause]

The question is…

Do I want too much?

[Verse 1: confident groove]

I like the mirror when it likes me back
I like the feeling of staying on track
I like the room when I know my worth
Like I finally learned what I came here for

I worked for the voice
I worked for the nerve
I learned not to beg
For what I deserve

But somewhere between
“I know I can”
And “I deserve the world”

[Backing Vocals]
Where’s the line?
Where’s the line?

[Pre-Chorus]

Is it confidence
When I stand up tall?

Is it pride
When I want it all?

Is it hunger
When I chase the flame?

Or narcissism
When everything becomes my name?

[Chorus: huge guitars]

WHERE DOES CONFIDENCE END
AND THE MIRROR BEGIN?

WHEN DOES WANTING MORE LIFE
BECOME NEEDING TO WIN?

I want the bigger room
The brighter light
The road that makes me feel alive

But if I burn down everything I love
Just to prove I can survive—

[Backing Choir]
Was it ambition?
Was it pride?

[Lead]
Or was I feeding something
That can never be satisfied?

[Verse 2: faster delivery]

I tell myself
“You only get one”

So why not chase
Every version of the sun?

More cities
More love
More stories
More names

More chances to become
Someone I haven’t been

[Backing Vocals]
More!
More!
More!

[Lead]
That’s the word that scares me most

Because “more” can build a future
Or turn your whole life into smoke

[Pre-Chorus]

I don’t want small
Just to look good

I don’t want shame
Where confidence stood

But if every ceiling
Must be broken through

What happens to the people
Standing underneath it too?

[Chorus]

WHERE DOES CONFIDENCE END
AND THE MIRROR BEGIN?

WHEN DOES SELF-BELIEF
TURN INTO NEEDING TO WIN?

I want to make
I want to grow
I want to see how far I go

But if nobody beside me
Can survive the speed I choose

What exactly did I gain
If everybody else I love
I lose?

[Bridge: piano only, intimate]

[Soft Vocal]

Maybe narcissism
Doesn’t always look like vanity

Maybe sometimes
It looks like destiny

Like believing
Your hunger is so important
Everyone else should absorb the cost

[Strings rise]

Maybe pride says
“I matter”

And something darker says

“I matter most”

[Pause]

And maybe the difference
Isn’t wanting more

Maybe it’s whether
Other people still exist
When I walk through the door

[Drums build]

[Verse 3: restrained, reflective]

I want a life that feels enormous
Without making others feel small

I want to trust my own desire
Without believing it outranks them all

I want to love myself
Without becoming
The only person I can see

I want ambition
Without destruction

I want freedom
With responsibility

[Final Chorus: key change]

WHERE DOES CONFIDENCE END?

MAYBE I HAVE TO ASK AGAIN

Every time the room gets brighter
Every time I start to win

Does this make me more alive?

Does this make me more alone?

Am I building something beautiful?

Or worshipping my own throne?

[Choir]
Confidence!

[Lead]
Know your worth

[Choir]
Pride!

[Lead]
Honor what you’ve earned

[Choir]
Ambition!

[Lead]
Reach for something more

[Choir]
But remember—

[Lead]
Other hearts
Are not the floor

[Final Refrain: music strips back]

I don’t want to fear my hunger

I don’t want to worship it

I want enough pride to chase a life
That actually feels like mine

And enough humility

To know
When wanting more

Has crossed the line

[Outro: piano, faint mirror-like synth]

[Spoken]
I still want more.

[Pause]

I just want to know
what I’m willing
to destroy for it.

[Final unresolved chord]

title: NOWHERE AND EVERYWHERE
lyrics:
[Intro: lone piano, distant train ambience]

[Spoken, low]
I always stay
until leaving hurts everyone.

[Pause]

Including me.

[Verse 1: intimate, restrained]

I learn the walls
I learn the names
I learn the rituals and little games

I make a home
I mean it too
That’s the cruelest part of what I do

I don’t arrive with one foot gone
I plant the roots
I carry on

Then somewhere deep beneath the floor
I hear another road
Behind another door

[Backing Vocals]
Stay
Go
Stay
Go

[Lead]
I wish my heart
Would choose one word

[Pre-Chorus: drums rising]

By the time I know
I need to leave

There are people
Who learned to believe

That I was permanent
That I was home

And I hate the way
My truth arrives so slow

[Chorus: huge guitars]

I BELONG NOWHERE
I BELONG EVERYWHERE

Every city feels like mine
Until I need another air

Every love becomes a universe
Every road becomes a prayer

I give my whole heart
Then discover

It was never built
To stay just there

[Verse 2: driving rhythm]

I’ve worn careers like favorite coats
Built identities from careful notes

“This is who I am”
“This is where I’ll be”

Then six months later
There’s another me

Another subject
Another town
Another reason to tear it down

Not from boredom
Not from spite

I just keep seeing
Too many possible lives

[Backing Vocals]
This one!
That one!
Both!
Again!

[Lead]
How do you commit
When every door says “When?”

[Pre-Chorus]

And the worst part is
I love them all

The people
The places
The rise and fall

So every pivot leaves a scar
Because I never leave
Before things matter

[Chorus]

I BELONG NOWHERE
I BELONG EVERYWHERE

Every person leaves a room in me
Every life leaves something there

I want roots
I want wings
I want contradictory things

I give my whole heart
Then discover

I can’t promise
One forever thing

[Bridge: drums drop, piano only]

[Soft Vocal]
Maybe I stayed too long
Trying to become
Someone who could stay

Maybe I confused
Consistency
With virtue

Maybe leaving earlier
Would have hurt less

[Pause]

But I didn’t know.

[String swell]

I keep thinking
The next life will fit

The next city
The next love
The next version of it

Then the horizon starts singing again

[Drums build]

And God help me

I still want to listen

[Final Chorus: key change]

I BELONG NOWHERE
I BELONG EVERYWHERE

I AM HOME IN EVERY MOMENT
UNTIL THE MOMENT NEEDS REPAIR

I will break hearts
Including mine

Trying to outrun
A straightened line

Maybe I was never built
For one road

One name

One life

One design

[Choir]
Nowhere!
Everywhere!

[Lead]
I don’t know
If that’s freedom
Or a flaw

[Choir]
Nowhere!
Everywhere!

[Lead]
I only know
I feel the pull
Before I know the cost

[Final Refrain: music strips back]

If I love you
Please believe me

If I leave you
Please believe me too

Both can be true
And that’s the wound

I can mean forever
In the moment

And still become
Someone new

[Outro: train sound slowly approaching]

[Soft Vocal]
I wish I knew
How to choose one path

[Pause]

But every road
Still looks like home

[Final unresolved chord]

title: EVERYTHING HAS TO CHANGE
lyrics:
[Intro: soft piano, distant room tone]

[Spoken, almost whispering]
How do you leave
something that helped build you?

[Pause]

How do you call it over
when it still matters?

[Verse 1: intimate vocal]

We built years into these walls
Memories hanging in the halls
Every season knows our names
Every room remembers change

There were mornings full of laughter
There were nights we barely made
There were promises we carried
There were pieces that we saved

And none of it was wasted
None of it was small
That’s what makes this ending
Feel impossible at all

[Pre-Chorus: strings enter]

Because I still care
Because I still know
Exactly what I’m losing
When I finally let it go

[Chorus: full band blooms]

EVERYTHING HAS TO CHANGE
EVEN THE THINGS I LOVE

Even the life I fought to keep
Even the hands I once dreamed of

I wish happiness
Had called me somewhere near

But it’s calling from a place
That means I cannot stay here

So I am breaking my own heart
To give tomorrow room to start

[Verse 2: steady drums]

I know every little rhythm
Every habit, every sign
I know where the floorboards creak
I know the shape of borrowed time

There is comfort in the known
Even when the known grows wrong
There is terror in admitting
You no longer fit the song

[Backing Vocals]
Stay
Stay
Stay

[Lead]
But staying out of history
Is not the same as staying free

[Pre-Chorus]

I can honor what we were
Without becoming what we were

I can love the road behind me
And still choose another turn

[Chorus]

EVERYTHING HAS TO CHANGE
EVEN THE THINGS I LOVE

Even the life I fought to keep
Even the hands I once dreamed of

I wish happiness
Had called me somewhere near

But it’s calling from a place
That means I cannot stay here

So I am breaking my own heart
To give tomorrow room to start

[Bridge: drums drop, piano only]

[Soft Vocal]
There is no villain here

No easy reason
No clean divide

Just the quiet realization
That I disappeared somewhere inside

[Strings rise]

And I miss the person
I might still become

I miss the unknown
I miss the sun

I miss the feeling
That my life is mine

[Pause]

And I can’t keep sacrificing
The future
To protect the past from time

[Build: toms and swelling guitar]

[Lead]
So take the photographs
Take the years
Take the gratitude and tears

Take the version of me
Who loved this life
With everything sincere

[Final Chorus: key change]

EVERYTHING HAS TO CHANGE
AND GOD, IT HURTS TO KNOW

That sometimes loving something deeply
Still means knowing when to go

I am not leaving
Because the meaning disappeared

I’m leaving because happiness
Finally became louder than my fear

I will grieve
I will shake
I will wonder if this was a mistake

But I would rather start again
Than slowly vanish where I stayed

[Final Refrain: instruments pull back]

Here’s to every year that mattered
Every memory I keep

Here’s to every promise
That I meant when it was spoken deep

Here’s to starting over
Without pretending nothing came before

I can close a meaningful chapter
And still love
What it was for

[Outro: piano only]

[Soft Vocal]
This mattered.

[Pause]

You mattered.

[Long pause]

And now…

I have to matter too.

[Final unresolved chord]

title: THE BEAUTIFUL PROBLEM
lyrics:
[Intro: bright piano, handclaps]

[Verse 1]
What an absurd complication
Too many people that I care
Too many invitations
Too much laughter everywhere

I could complain about the calendar
Or curse the lack of clones
But maybe having too much love
Is not the worst of unknowns

[Chorus]
WHAT A BEAUTIFUL PROBLEM TO HAVE
MORE PEOPLE THAN TIME

More hugs than weekends
More hearts crossing mine

Yes, it’s messy
Yes, it’s tiring
Yes, I sometimes lose the plot

But once I feared I’d be alone

[Verse 2]
Someone wants a dinner
Someone wants a walk
Someone has a crisis
Someone just wants to talk

And somewhere in the chaos
I need a night for me

Love became so plentiful
I’m learning how to breathe

[Bridge]
Gratitude doesn’t cancel limits

Something can be overwhelming

[Final Chorus]
WHAT A BEAUTIFUL PROBLEM TO HAVE
TOO MUCH LOVE TO FIT THE WEEK

I’ll learn boundaries
I’ll learn balance
I’ll learn when to rest and speak

I won’t curse the crowded heart
For every complicated part

[Outro]
Too many people to love.

[Soft laugh]

Lucky me.

title: I CAN’T BE EVERYWHERE
lyrics:
[Intro: distorted guitar, frantic notification sounds]

[Spoken]
Three messages.
Two dinners.
One body.

Great.

[Verse 1]
Everybody wants a little
And I want to give it all
But my battery is blinking
And I’m missing every call

I have run from room to room
Trying not to disappoint
Till I finally disappeared
At every single meeting point

[Chorus: explosive]
I CAN’T BE EVERYWHERE!
I CAN’T BE EVERYTHING!

Loving you does not require
That I answer every ring

I will show up
I will care
I will tell you when I’m bare

But I refuse to break myself
To prove that I am there

[Bridge: half-time]
If my love requires destruction
Then we’ve misunderstood the deal
I want connection built on honesty
Not exhaustion dressed as real

[Final Chorus]
I CAN’T BE EVERYWHERE
BUT WHEN I’M THERE I’LL REALLY BE

No ghost behind a smiling face

[Outro]
One body.
One life.
Still plenty of love.

title: YOU ARE NOT BEING REPLACED
lyrics:
[Intro: soft heartbeat, warm synth]

[Verse 1]
I saw your eyes go distant
When another person came
Like somewhere deep inside you
A quiet alarm became

“If they matter
Do I matter?
If they’re new
Am I now old?”

Come here
Let me answer
Before the fear gets hold

[Chorus]
YOU ARE NOT BEING REPLACED
NO ONE STOLE YOUR PLACE

Love is not a single chair
Where only one can stay

New connection
New affection
Doesn’t rewrite yesterday

You are not being replaced
I’m simply learning more ways to care

[Bridge]
I can’t promise nothing changes
Every living thing must move
But change is not deletion
Growth is not removal too

[Final Chorus]
YOU ARE NOT BEING REPLACED
YOU DON’T HAVE TO WIN

No one needs to lose their meaning
For another love to begin

[Outro]
You are still here.
So am I.

title: MORE THAN ONE LIGHT
lyrics:
[Intro: filtered synth pulse, distant club ambience]

[Whispered Vocals]
No labels.
No limits.
Just light.

[Beat drops]

[Verse 1: sleek, restrained]

I came alive beneath the neon
Where nobody asked me to explain
Why one spark can lead to another
Why every color hits a different vein

Some people dance in straight lines
Some people circle around
I like the way the whole room changes
When every kind of beauty comes down

[Backing Vocals]
Left side
Right side
All night

[Lead]
Why choose one star
When the whole sky’s bright?

[Pre-Chorus: synths rising]

No cages
No claims
No little boxes around our names

Just honesty
Heat
And room to breathe

If the feeling’s real
Why make it leave?

[Chorus: huge, euphoric]

MORE THAN ONE LIGHT
CAN BURN IN THE NIGHT

MORE THAN ONE HEART
CAN MAKE THE WORLD FEEL RIGHT

No one gets smaller
No one disappears

We make more room
We make it clear

There’s enough wonder
Enough desire

Enough space
For more than one fire

[Post-Chorus: festival drop]

[Chopped Vocals]
More
Than
One

More
Than
One

[Verse 2: deeper bass, playful delivery]

I like the mystery in strangers
The way a new soul bends the air
The different ways that people shimmer
When you stop deciding who belongs where

Maybe love was never narrow

Maybe hearts were built like cities

[Backing Vocals]
Come close
Step back
Come near

[Lead]
Freedom sounds better

[Pre-Chorus]

No hierarchy written in stone
No one has to stand alone

Different rhythm
Different flame

Nothing beautiful

[Chorus]

MORE THAN ONE LIGHT
CAN BURN IN THE NIGHT

MORE THAN ONE HEART
CAN MAKE THE WORLD FEEL RIGHT

No one gets smaller
No one disappears

We make more room
We make it clear

There’s enough wonder
Enough desire

Enough space
For more than one fire

[Bridge: drums cut, airy synth]

[Soft Vocal]
Maybe the secret
Was never choosing less

Maybe it’s learning
How to care without possession

How to stay honest
Without closing every door

How to let connection
Become something more

[Build: kick returns gradually]

[Choir]
More room
More truth
More life
More you

[Lead]
And somehow
More me too

[Final Chorus: massive]

MORE THAN ONE LIGHT
CAN BURN IN THE NIGHT

MORE THAN ONE HEART
CAN MAKE THE WORLD FEEL RIGHT

Let every color
Enter the frame

Let every connection
Keep its own name

No one gets smaller
No one loses fire

We just keep widening
The shape of desire

[Final Drop]

[All Vocals]
MORE THAN ONE LIGHT!

[Chopped Vocals]
More than one
More than one
More than one

[Outro: pulsing synth fading]

[Whispered Vocal]
No labels.
No limits.

[Pause]

Just light.

[Final bass hit]

title: DIFFERENT LOVE, SAME WEIGHT
lyrics:
[Intro: alternating piano and guitar themes]

[Verse 1]
With you I talk till morning
With them I dance till two
Someone else brings quiet comfort
No one loves exactly like you

One bond feels like lightning
One feels like coming home
Another feels like wandering
Where I’ve never gone alone

[Chorus]
DIFFERENT LOVE
SAME WEIGHT

NOT EVERY HEART
HAS TO LOOK THE SAME

Different rhythm
Different language
Different doorway
Different flame

Don’t compare the shape of closeness
Don’t confuse variety with fate

Different love
Same weight

[Bridge]
A violin is not a trumpet
Still they both can fill the air
Why demand identical music
Just to prove the song is fair?

[Final Chorus]
DIFFERENT LOVE
SAME WEIGHT

LET EACH CONNECTION HAVE ITS NAME

No ranking
No imitation
No requirement to be the same

[Outro]
Different
doesn’t mean less.

title: THE PEOPLE I HAVEN’T MET YET
lyrics:
[Intro: shimmering synth, train wheels]

[Verse 1]
Somewhere there’s a stranger laughing
At a joke I haven’t heard
Someone has a favorite story
Still completely without words

Someone walking through a city
Has no idea I exist
And perhaps a year from now
I’ll know the shape of how they kiss

[Chorus]
HERE’S TO THE PEOPLE I HAVEN’T MET YET
THE WORLDS I HAVEN’T SEEN

The conversations waiting
In the spaces in between

I love the hearts already near me
But life keeps opening the gate

How can I pretend my story’s finished
When connection still awaits?

[Bridge]
It doesn’t make today’s love smaller
To admit tomorrow’s unknown
The heart can honor where it’s living
While remaining free to grow

[Final Chorus]
HERE’S TO THE PEOPLE I HAVEN’T MET YET
AND EVERYONE I LOVE TODAY

May no new light erase an old one
May they simply find their place

[Outro]
Somewhere
another hello is coming.

title: I NEED TO BELONG TO MYSELF TOO
lyrics:
[Intro: piano, deep breath]

[Verse 1]
I saved my nights for everybody
Kept my mornings open wide
If somebody needed something
I would move myself aside

Then one day I met the silence
And it asked me where I’d been
I had made room for every person
Except the one beneath my skin

[Chorus]
I NEED TO BELONG TO MYSELF TOO
NOT ONLY TO THE ONES I LOVE

I need hours nobody owns
A little sky nobody touches

I can give you all my kindness
Without surrendering my name

I need to be somebody
When nobody calls my name

[Bridge]
Self-love isn’t subtraction
It isn’t taking yours away
It’s remembering I’m a person
I must also choose each day

[Final Chorus]
I NEED TO BELONG TO MYSELF TOO
SO I HAVE SOME SELF TO GIVE

I don’t want to love by vanishing
I want both of us to live

[Outro]
Tonight
I’m keeping me.

title: A THOUSAND GOODBYES EVERY DAY
lyrics:
[Intro: train ambience, acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
Every morning starts with choosing
Every choice excludes a road
Breakfast here means missing someone
Rest means setting down the load

Dinner with one person
Means another waits at home
Every yes contains a tiny no
No matter where I roam

[Chorus]
A THOUSAND GOODBYES EVERY DAY
NONE OF THEM FOREVER

Every life we choose to enter
Means leaving some together

I hate the doors that close behind me
Even knowing they’ll reopen soon

There are only so many places
One heart can be by noon

[Bridge]
Maybe loving many people
Means becoming good at leaving
Not disappearing
Not abandoning
Just trusting in returning

[Final Chorus]
A THOUSAND GOODBYES EVERY DAY
AND A THOUSAND HELLOS TOO

Maybe absence isn’t ending
Maybe distance can be true

[Outro]
See you later
is still a kind of love.

title: PLEASE DON’T COUNT THE HOURS
lyrics:
[Intro: clock ticks, mellow bass]

[Verse 1]
You saw them twice
I saw you once
And suddenly the math begins

Who got Saturday
Who got Sunday
Who got messages at ten?

But affection isn’t payroll
And attention isn’t proof
Sometimes one hour holds more closeness
Than a week beneath one roof

[Chorus]
PLEASE DON’T COUNT THE HOURS
DON’T TURN LOVE INTO A SCORE

You are not the minutes given
You are something so much more

Some weeks bend
Some seasons change
Some connections need more care

Don’t mistake uneven time
For uneven love that’s there

[Bridge]
Measure me by honesty
By whether I return
By whether I still know your fears
And what makes your spirit burn

[Final Chorus]
PLEASE DON’T COUNT THE HOURS
COUNT THE MOMENTS THAT ARE TRUE

I don’t want a spreadsheet
Standing between my heart and you

[Outro]
Time is uneven.
Love doesn’t have to be.

title: THE GUILT OF GOING HOME
lyrics:
[Intro: rain, soft piano]

[Verse 1]
You asked if I could stay a while
I wanted to say yes
But something in my tired bones
Was begging me for rest

So I kissed your head
Closed the door
Walked alone beneath the glow

And every step toward my own bed
Felt like choosing you less somehow

[Chorus]
WHY DOES GOING HOME FEEL GUILTY
WHEN I KNOW I NEED THE SPACE?

Why does caring for myself
Feel like abandoning your face?

I can love you
Miss you
Need you
Still need solitude tonight

Going home is not rejection
Rest is not goodbye

[Bridge]
Maybe I was taught that loving
Means remaining till you’re gone
But a heart can leave the room
And keep the tenderness turned on

[Final Chorus]
I’M GOING HOME WITHOUT APOLOGY
THOUGH I STILL MAY FEEL IT sting

I can choose myself this evening
Without undoing anything

[Outro]
Goodnight.
Not goodbye.

title: LOVE HAS NO LIMIT, I DO
lyrics:
[Intro: synth pulse, soft strings]

[Verse 1]
My heart keeps stretching wider
Like it never found an edge
Every person leaves a color
Every promise leaves a thread

But my body counts the hours
My mind eventually says stop
Love may pour forever
But the vessel has a top

[Chorus]
LOVE HAS NO LIMIT
I DO

That’s the painful little truth

I can care beyond exhaustion
But exhaustion still comes through

I can want to hold the whole world
Still need sleep at half past two

Love has no limit
I do

[Bridge]
And limits aren’t betrayal
They’re the shape of being alive
If I burn myself to prove my love
What exactly survives?

[Final Chorus]
LOVE HAS NO LIMIT
I DO

So I’ll give what I can give true

Not infinity
Not perfection
Just an honest piece of you-know-who

[Outro]
My limits don’t measure my love.

title: EVERYONE DESERVES THE FULL VERSION
lyrics:
[Intro: lonely piano]

[Verse 1]
You deserve the version laughing
Not the one that’s barely there
Not the eyes behind a screen
Saying, “Sorry, yes, I care”

You deserve my curiosity
My patience and my spark
Not whatever little fragment
I can scrape out after dark

[Chorus]
EVERYONE DESERVES THE FULL VERSION
NOT THE LEFTOVERS OF ME

But I cannot stay completely full
For everyone I see

I keep giving
Keep dividing
Till the signal starts to fade

Then I hate the half-attention
That exhaustion makes me trade

[Bridge: drums drop]
Maybe love means disappointing
Someone now and then
So I can rest enough
To meet them fully
When I come again

[Final Chorus]
YOU DESERVE THE FULL VERSION
SO SOMETIMES I MUST GO

I would rather miss an evening
Than arrive with nothing whole

[Outro]
Let me recharge.
Then let me really see you.

title: I DON’T WANT TO LOVE YOU EFFICIENTLY
lyrics:
[Intro: metronome, piano stabs]

[Spoken]
Tuesday, 7:30.
Forty-five minutes for intimacy.

Absolutely not.

[Verse 1]
I don’t want to schedule wonder
Between errands and a call
I want conversations stretching
Till we don’t know time at all

I don’t want optimized affection
Color-coded on a screen
I want messy, useless evenings
Where you tell me what you mean

[Chorus]
I DON’T WANT TO LOVE YOU EFFICIENTLY
I WANT TO WASTE SOME TIME

Lose an hour to your story
Lose another to your mind

Real connection has no shortcut
Depth refuses to be neat

If loving you costs hours
Then those hours aren’t defeat

[Verse 2]
But there are others that I cherish
And a body needs to rest
So I keep fighting with the calendar
While trying to give my best

[Bridge]
Maybe presence cannot scale
Maybe that’s what makes it rare
Not love itself
But being fully
Undistractedly there

[Final Chorus]
I DON’T WANT TO LOVE YOU EFFICIENTLY
DON’T TURN MY HEART TO MATH

I’d rather give you one real evening
Than ten distracted halves

[Outro]
No optimization.
Just stay.

title: A HOUSE WITH TOO MANY ROOMS
lyrics:
[Intro: piano, creaking door]

[Verse 1]
My heart became a house somehow
And every person built a room
One filled up with summer mornings
One still smells of cheap perfume

There are rooms for long conversations
Rooms for dancing after two
Rooms I never knew I needed
Until one belonged to you

[Pre-Chorus]
But there’s only one of me
Walking every hall

[Chorus]
I BUILT A HOUSE WITH TOO MANY ROOMS
AND I LOVE EVERY LIGHT

But I cannot sit beside each window
Every single night

If your room goes quiet
Please don’t think I’ve gone

I’m somewhere down another hallway
Trying to keep the whole house warm

[Bridge: orchestral swell]
Maybe love keeps adding stories
Maybe that’s the beautiful curse
More doors open
More hearts enter
One caretaker doing their worst

[Final Chorus]
A HOUSE WITH TOO MANY ROOMS
STILL HAS ONE FRONT DOOR

I may leave your lamp unattended
But I never love you less for more

[Outro]
Leave the light on.
I’ll come back through.

title: NO ONE SHOULD FEEL SECOND
lyrics:
[Intro: soft guitar, heartbeat kick]

[Verse 1]
I see the question in your eyes
When somebody else walks in
“Did I lose a little ground?
Did another story win?”

But love is not a podium
There is no silver place
Different hands can hold me differently
Without erasing any face

[Chorus]
NO ONE SHOULD FEEL SECOND
NO ONE SHOULD FEEL SMALL

I don’t want my love for someone
To make you question yours at all

Different doesn’t mean diminished
New does not replace

Every bond can have its own weight
Its own rhythm, room, and shape

[Verse 2]
You may get my quiet mornings
They may get my midnight drive
Someone else gets endless laughter
All of it is still alive

[Bridge: strings rise]
I cannot make every connection
Look identical and true
But I can make one promise:
I will never measure you

[Final Chorus]
NO ONE SHOULD FEEL SECOND
LOVE IS NOT A RACE

You don’t need to beat another heart
To keep your sacred place

[Outro, soft]
You are not less
Because I love more.

title: THE CALENDAR IS THE ENEMY
lyrics:
[Intro: ticking clock, warm piano]

[Spoken]
My heart keeps saying yes.
My calendar has other ideas.

[Verse 1]
I could spend a lifetime learning
Every way you laugh and ache
Then another heart comes shining
With another world to make

Nobody’s stealing anything
Nobody loved me wrong
There are simply twenty-four small hours
And the wanting is too strong

[Pre-Chorus]
Love says, “Stay”
Time says, “Go”
How can both be true?

[Chorus: soaring]
THE CALENDAR IS THE ENEMY
NOT YOU, NOT THEM, NOT ME

I’ve got oceans worth of feeling
And one body trying to be

Everywhere that love is calling
Every place I want to stay

My heart keeps making promises
My hours cannot pay

[Bridge: drums drop]
If I could split myself in pieces
I’d send one to every door
But I’d rather give you something real
Than pretend that I have more

[Final Chorus]
THE CALENDAR IS THE ENEMY
LOVE WAS NEVER SCARCE

Only mornings
Only evenings
Only miles between our hearts

[Outro]
I don’t love you less
I just ran out of day.

title: ONLY ONE OF ME
lyrics:
[Intro: soft piano, distant room tone]

[Spoken, quietly]
I wish I could show up
for everyone
exactly when they need me.

[Pause]

But there is only one of me.

[Verse 1]

I want to know the shape of every heart
The hidden place where all the stories start

I want to sit beside the quiet pain
Learn every joy
Remember every name

I want to love in ways that feel complete
Not passing warmth
But something deep

To make each person feel
Seen and known

Not one more face
Among a crowd alone

[Pre-Chorus]

And that would all be beautiful

If time did not exist

If every hour could split itself
Into another kiss

[Chorus: strings swell]

I WANT TO GIVE EVERYONE
THE LOVE THEY DESERVE

THE KIND THAT STAYS
THE KIND THAT LEARNS

I want to hold each fragile truth
And never make a heart feel used

But there are only so many nights
Only so much energy

So much love inside this body

And only one of me

[Verse 2: light drums enter]

Someone needs a conversation
Someone needs a hand

Someone wants a quiet evening
Someone wants me where they stand

Someone misses how I listened
Someone wonders if I’ve changed

And every unanswered message
Feels like affection rearranged

[Backing Vocals]
Do I matter?
Are you there?
Did I lose
My little share?

[Lead]
No, no
That’s the hardest part

Love can grow without a limit
But attention has a start

And an end

[Pre-Chorus]

I don’t want to make a ranking
I don’t want to keep a score

I don’t want one person’s closeness
To make another feel ignored

But every yes is time from somewhere
Every promise takes a piece

And sometimes loving everyone
Means learning when to leave

[Chorus]

I WANT TO GIVE EVERYONE
THE LOVE THEY DESERVE

THE KIND THAT STAYS
THE KIND THAT LEARNS

I want to know your deepest dreams
And every hidden in-between

But there are only so many mornings
Only so much I can be

So much love inside this body

And only one of me

[Bridge: piano only]

[Soft Vocal]

Maybe love is not
Being endlessly available

Maybe love is honesty
Before exhaustion turns invisible

Maybe saying
“I cannot tonight”

Can still mean
“You matter to me”

Maybe care does not become less true
Because I need to breathe

[Strings rise]

I want to give from something living

Not from emptiness and fear

I want my presence to feel chosen

Not like someone disappearing here

[Final Chorus: huge]

I STILL WANT TO GIVE EVERYONE
THE LOVE THEY DESERVE

THE KIND THAT SEES
THE KIND THAT SERVES

I want you held
I want you known
I want no heart to feel alone

But I have only one pair of hands
Only one place I can be

A thousand rooms inside my heart

And only one of me

[Choir]
One of me
One of me

[Lead]
So if I need a little distance

[Choir]
It isn’t less

[Lead]
If I miss a night or answer late

[Choir]
It isn’t less

[Lead]
I am learning love can still be deep

Without giving every breath

[Final Refrain]

I cannot be
Everything
To everyone
I see

But I can love you honestly

With the part of life
That’s mine to give

And maybe that is not a failure

Maybe that’s the way
Love gets to live

[Outro: piano and soft choir]

[Whispered Vocal]
So many people to love

[Pause]

Only one of me

[Final unresolved chord]

title: NOT TODAY, FEET
lyrics:
[Intro: soft piano, room ambience]

[Spoken]
Yesterday we walked everywhere.

Today…

[Pause]

Absolutely not.

[Verse 1: sleepy groove]

My feet have filed a formal claim
My knees refuse to play the game
My calves are sending warning signs
My back has unionized

Yesterday was mile on mile
Still somehow worth it all the while
But morning came and every bone
Said, “Please just leave us all alone”

[Backing Vocals]
Sit down
Lie back
Put those shoes away

[Lead]
The world can keep on moving
I am staying here today

[Chorus: warm guitars enter]

NOT TODAY, FEET
YOU’VE DONE ENOUGH

Yesterday we asked you
For entirely too much

Let the muscles loosen
Let the heartbeat slow

There is nowhere that important
We absolutely have to go

Rest the body
Clear the head
Find a pillow
Find a bed

Yesterday we chased the world

Today we let it come instead

[Verse 2: playful bass]

The couch has never looked so fine
This blanket understands my mind
A glass of water by my side
And zero plans involving strides

No step counter judging me
No scenic route I need to see
If something’s more than ten feet out

[Backing Vocals]
Delivery!

[Lead]
That’s what modern life is about

[Pre-Chorus]

Rest isn’t quitting
Rest isn’t waste

Sometimes recovery
Is exactly the pace

The body kept the promise
Yesterday from dawn till night

So today I’ll return the favor
And treat the poor thing right

[Chorus]

NOT TODAY, FEET
YOU’VE DONE ENOUGH

Yesterday we asked you
For entirely too much

Let the muscles loosen
Let the heartbeat slow

There is nowhere that important
We absolutely have to go

[Bridge: drums drop, dreamy guitar]

[Soft Vocal]

Every adventure leaves a little bill

A sore ankle
A stiff hip
A body asking us to sit still

And maybe listening
Is part of being alive

You can’t keep running beautifully
If you never stop the drive

[Instrumental: gentle guitar flourish]

[Final Chorus: fuller harmonies]

NOT TODAY, FEET
TAKE THE DAY OFF

No heroic journeys
No pretending we’re not soft

Stretch a little
Breathe it in
Let recovery begin

Tomorrow we can wander

But today…

[Music cuts]

We’re staying in.

[Outro: piano only]

[Spoken]
Feet?

[Backing Vocals]
Yes?

[Lead]
Thank you for your service.

[Soft laughter]

[Final chord]

title: I NEED TO KNOW YOUR FIRE
lyrics:
[Intro: piano stabs, finger snaps, low bass]

[Spoken]
I don’t just want your name.

I want to know
what keeps you awake.

[Drum hit]

[Verse 1: fast, playful]

I want the story
Behind the smile
The thing you wanted
When you were a child

The song you play
When nobody’s near
The dream you hide
When the room can hear

I want the joke
That makes you fold
The scar you never
Quite retold

I don’t just want
A pretty face

[Backing Vocals]
Then what do you want?

[Lead]
I want the map
Behind the place

[Pre-Chorus]

Every person is a locked-up room
With another little universe inside

And I keep falling for the moment
When somebody finally
Opens it wide

[Chorus: huge guitars]

I NEED TO KNOW YOUR FIRE
WHAT MOVES YOUR SOUL

WHAT MAKES YOU LOSE YOUR MIND
WHAT MAKES YOU WHOLE

I want the spark
I want the truth

I want that midnight
“What made you you?”

And when I find it
God, I want it again

That impossible second

When two strangers
Stop being strangers

[Verse 2: bouncing piano]

I love the first confession
After two more drinks

The sudden little silence
Before somebody thinks

“Should I really tell you this?”

[Backing Vocals]
Tell him!

[Lead]
Yes, please.

I want your contradictions
Your terrible opinions

The part of you
That doesn’t fit
In neat little descriptions

One heart
Then another
Another world unfolds

I keep collecting
Tiny truths

Not trophies

[Music cuts]

Souls.

[Pre-Chorus]

Maybe I need many mirrors
To see all the ways
A person can be

Maybe every real connection
Unlocks another
Version of me

[Chorus]

I NEED TO KNOW YOUR FIRE
WHAT MOVES YOUR SOUL

WHAT MAKES YOU RUN
WHAT MAKES YOU LOSE CONTROL

I want the fear
Behind the charm

The reason you still
Guard your heart

And when I find it
God, I want it again

That beautiful collision

When two people
Become real

[Bridge: piano only, intimate]

[Soft Vocal]
It’s not about numbers.

It’s not about winning.

It’s the hunger
To understand.

[Strings enter]

How many entire worlds
Walk past us every day?

How many people
Could change us

If we stayed long enough
To ask?

[Drums build]

I don’t want affection
Without discovery

I don’t want romance
Without curiosity

I want to meet the person
Behind the performance

Again

And again

And again

[Final Chorus: key change]

I NEED TO KNOW YOUR FIRE
LET ME SEE THE CORE

THE THING YOU NEVER
SHOW ANYBODY ANYMORE

Tell me your wonder
Tell me your shame

Tell me what happens
When nobody’s saying your name

I want the spark
I want the depth

I want the moment
We forget what’s left

And if tomorrow
Another soul shines through

I want to know
What makes them
Them too

[Outro: piano, handclaps]

[Lead]
Maybe love is partly
Learning how to see

[Backing Vocals]
See what?

[Lead]
The whole strange universe
Inside somebody

[Pause]

Then falling in love
With discovery

[Final piano crash]

title: DON’T GIVE ME A KEY
lyrics:
[Intro: sharp piano stabs, finger snaps]

[Spoken]
You should probably know this
before you clear a drawer.

[Drum hit]

[Verse 1: fast, playful]

I like the spark
I like the chase
I like the look before we name the place

I like your clothes
On my bedroom floor
I just get nervous when you say
“Forevermore”

[Backing Vocals]
Uh-oh!

[Lead]
You say, “Stay”
I hear, “Build a fence”

You say, “Us”
I start losing common sense

It’s not that I don’t feel it
God, I feel it way too much

I just panic when affection
Starts discussing joint accounts

[Pre-Chorus: drums building]

Don’t mistake my running
For an empty heart

Sometimes I leave
Because I care enough
To fear the part—

[Chorus: huge guitars]

DON’T GIVE ME A KEY
I MIGHT LOVE YOU AND LEAVE

I’M GREAT AT THE FIRE
I’M BAD AT THE EVE

I can promise you tonight
I can mean every word

But ask me where we’ll be in five years

[Music cuts]

And suddenly I haven’t heard

[Backing Vocals]
Run! Run! Run!

[Lead]
I want the love
I fear the cage

I’m still learning
How to stay

[Verse 2: bouncing piano and bass]

I know the drill
I’ve seen the scene

Two toothbrushes
And a matching washing machine

Sunday brunch
A little dog
A shared account
And matching monologues

[Brass flourish]

And maybe that’s beautiful
Maybe I’m strange

But every time things settle
I start craving a change

I love being chosen
That’s the terrible twist

The second I feel owned
I start checking the exits

[Pre-Chorus]

I don’t want less feeling
I want room to breathe

Can you hold me
Without asking me
To promise I won’t leave?

[Chorus]

DON’T GIVE ME A KEY
I MIGHT LOVE YOU AND LEAVE

I’M GREAT AT THE FIRE
I’M BAD AT THE EVE

I can promise you honesty
I can promise I care

But if love means disappearing
Into somebody else’s chair—

[Backing Vocals]
No! No! No!

[Lead]
I need a door
I need a name

That still belongs to me

[Bridge: piano only]

[Soft Vocal]
Maybe commitment
Isn’t chains

Maybe staying
Isn’t losing

Maybe choosing you tomorrow
Means tomorrow
I keep choosing

[Strings rise]

Not because I have to

Not because I swore

But because every morning
I still want to
Open your door

[Drums explode back in]

[Final Chorus]

SO MAYBE GIVE ME A KEY
BUT DON’T THROW OUT MY SHOES

LET ME STAY BECAUSE I WANT TO
NOT BECAUSE I CAN’T REFUSE

I may always need a window
I may always fear the wall

But maybe love is not a prison

[Choir]
IF THERE’S ROOM TO MOVE AT ALL!

[Outro: piano and handclaps]

[Lead]
I’m hard to settle

[Backing Vocals]
We noticed!

[Lead]
Hard to own

[Backing Vocals]
Good!

[Lead]
But maybe I can learn
To make a home

Without becoming
One.

[Final piano crash]

title: Shake It Off Tonight
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Heavy words on my back
Dragging heels on the floor
Got that cloud in my chest
And I don't want it no more

I'm stepping out the dark
With my hands in the air
One move, then another
Like the hurt wasn't there

[Pre-Chorus]
Spin me around
Till it falls apart
Spare me now
I don't need the start

[Chorus]
Dance it away, dance it away
Dance it away tonight
(away tonight)
Dance it away, dance it away
Leave all the weight outside
(outside)

Dance it away, dance it away
Watch the bad news fade
(fade away)
Dance it away, dance it away
Till my heart feels made

[Verse 2]
I was stuck in the corners
With my jaw set tight
Now I'm cutting through the room
In my black and white

Every step says bye
To the noise in my head
Every turn says I
Get to live again

[Pre-Chorus]
Spin me around
Till it falls apart
Spare me now
I don't need the start

[Chorus]
Dance it away, dance it away
Dance it away tonight
(away tonight)
Dance it away, dance it away
Leave all the weight outside
(outside)

Dance it away, dance it away
Watch the bad news fade
(fade away)
Dance it away, dance it away
Till my heart feels made

[Bridge]
If it comes back again
I'll be back on the floor
Two feet, one prayer
And a little bit more

[Final Chorus]
Dance it away, dance it away
Dance it away tonight
(away tonight)
Dance it away, dance it away
Leave all the weight outside
(outside)

Dance it away, dance it away
Watch the bad news fade
(fade away)
Dance it away, dance it away
Till my heart feels made

title: WE WILL ALWAYS RISE
lyrics:
[Intro: feedback squeal, snare count-in]

[Gang Shout]
ONE! TWO! THREE! FOUR!

[Verse 1: fast distorted guitars]

We have hit the pavement hard
Worn the bruises, kept the scars
Heard the voices say we’re done
Still we wake to face the sun

Every setback
Every fall
Every night against the wall

Made us louder
Made us wise
Made us learn—

[Gang Vocals]
WE ALWAYS RISE!

[Pre-Chorus: drums double-time]

Let the doors slam
Let the lights go black

We know how to lose
And still come back

[Chorus: huge gang vocals]

WE WILL ALWAYS RISE!

THROUGH THE FIRE
THROUGH THE FIGHT

WE WILL ALWAYS RISE!

WHEN THE WORLD SAYS
“NOT TONIGHT”

Maybe now
Maybe now

God, I do

The hole still knows my name

[Bridge: drums drop out]

[Strings rise]

Give it away
Let it return

Even if some corners never learn

Give it away
Let it remain

Love does not have to erase the pain

So do you
So do you

And tonight

I like the way a kindness lands

Maybe tomorrow

Paint my heart calm

title: Hands Full Empty

Hands full, empty

title: Cracked Lunch Tray
lyrics:
[Verse 1]

Kept my stories old

What they left behind
Not a flaw in my soul
Just a wound in time

[Chorus]
I am not broken
I am becoming
I am not broken
I’m just unlearning

They do not own me
I am not broken
I am becoming

I say “it’s fine” too fast

I overread the room

I people-please, then disappear

I joke before I trust

[Pre-Chorus]
Now I flinch at a laugh
That sounds too sharp
I build little walls
In the shape of my heart

What they left behind

I am not broken
I am becoming
I am not broken
I’m just unlearning

I am becoming

I’m just unlearning

They do not own me
I am not broken
I am becoming

I am becoming

title: Burn the Maps
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I watched the days go by
Like coins through a hole
Kept every dream on hold
Telling myself, "later"

But the mirror kept the score
On the lines I wore
Said if I wanted more
I'd have to reach for it

[Pre-Chorus]
So I sold my easy life

To find what I can feel

[Chorus]
I’ll pay the price
I’ll pay the price
For a life that feels alive
I’ll pay the price
I’ll pay the price
To know I really tried
(Really tried)
If it takes all I have
I’m still standing here
I’ll pay the price
For a life that feels alive

[Verse 2]
I lost some friends to time
Lost sleep, lost pride
Had to let some old truths die
On the floor behind me

Every road had thorns
Every win had scars
Still I kept my hands on the wheel
And my eyes on what’s in me

[Pre-Chorus]
No, I won’t stay small

[Chorus]
I’ll pay the price
I’ll pay the price
For a life that feels alive
I’ll pay the price
I’ll pay the price

I’m still standing here
I’ll pay the price
For a life that feels alive

I’ll pay the price
I’ll pay the price
For a life that feels alive
I’ll pay the price
I’ll pay the price

I’m still standing here

title: Listening Late

[Verse 1]

[Pre-Chorus]
Now the silence

I replay

I wish I listened
I wish I stayed
I wish I called you

I wish I listened
To what you gave
You held me steady

If I could turn
One mile back
I'd answer sooner
I'd hold your hand
I'd make the time
I'd do it right

I was that night

I wish I listened
I wish I stayed
I wish I called you

I wish I listened
To what you gave

title: Could Have Been Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I missed the signs you sent
Left them on the table
Said I had time to change

And all the keys I kept

Before it was too late

[Chorus]
I could have been better
I could have been more

I could have been better
Right down to the core
(too late, too late)

title: Open Hands

Open hands

I can breathe

Carry me

Open hands
Let it stay
Open hands
I am safe

I can bend
I can breathe

Carry me

title: THE UNIVERSE WON’T MIND
lyrics:
[Intro: jaunty piano]

[Spoken]
Ladies and gentlemen…

I have terrible news.

[Pause]

None of us are getting out of this alive.

[Bright brass hit]

So shall we dance?

Tick-tock!

So loosen up the necktie

We’ll complain about it when it’s there

With extraordinarily limited time

Wear the trousers you adore

Laugh too loudly
Love too much
Order something strange tonight

[Choir]
You’ll never get out alive!

Terrible management!
No respect for shareholders!

Meanwhile children built a kingdom

Somewhere.

In the grand synopsis

DON’T TAKE IT SO SERIOUSLY

Sing loudly in the shower

Nobody at the end will say

You’ll never get out alive!

Ba-da-ba!

Because you wore two different socks last week

When to hold…

[Drums build]

[Lead]
And occasionally—

[Choir]
Order dessert!

DON’T TAKE IT SO SERIOUSLY
THE UNIVERSE WON’T MIND

On borrowed cosmic time

Call your mother
Kiss your lover
Take your shoes off on the floor

Nobody at the end will say

“THEY SHOULD HAVE WORRIED MORE!”

Make mistakes
Change your mind
Take the long way when you drive

Don’t take it so seriously

You’ll never get out—

Well…

Technically.

[Full band explosion]

[Choir]
ALIVE!

The planets keep on spinning

Spin, spin, spin!

Whether you’re prepared or not

You get one astonishing ticket

So enjoy the bloody plot

And when you catch yourself believing
Every problem is divine

Just remember—

The universe won’t mind.

[Final piano flourish]

[Spoken]
Dessert?

title: ROSE BY ANY OTHER NAME
lyrics:
[Intro: grand piano flourish]

And everybody magnificent in between!

[Guitar sting]

I said—

Ooooh!

Why would I interrogate the dawn

Before they celebrate

Blueprint!
Lipstick!
Mystery!
Bliss!

[Guitar answer]

[Piano faster]

[Guitar faster]

[Saxophone barges in]

[Silence]

[Lead, softly]
I wouldn’t.

[String swell]

Wear the crown

Rewrite the part

Ba-da-da-da!

Yesterday can keep its photographs

A chart!

I’ll draw one arrow to my heart

[Final Chorus: key change, massive choir]

A ROSE IS A ROSE WHEN IT’S KISSING MY CHEEK
A STAR IS A STAR WHETHER GENTLE OR FREAK

Let the historians argue
Let philosophers insist

[Pause]

On the architecture of your kiss

[Choir]
THE ARCHITECTURE!

Columns of laughter

[Choir]
THE ARCHITECTURE!

[Lead]
Windows of bliss

[Choir]
THE ARCHITECTURE!

An unnecessarily elaborate staircase—

To this.

Who you are
Who you are
Who you are

Is the woman that I see

Still a rose

Star by any other sky

Love by any winding road

Be afraid

Without making broken last

We can’t rewrite yesterday

But tomorrow’s still unwritten

And sometimes the first sentence is

“I forgive you”

[Final Hook: layered vocals]

Let it go
Let it grow

You don’t have to carry
What somebody did years ago

Let it breathe
Let it leave

Forgiveness ain’t weakness
It’s choosing to be free

We all fall
We all break

We all need some mercy
For the choices that we make

So forgive
When you can

Not because they earned it

Because peace deserves a chance

[Outro]

Forgive them

Forgive yourself

Keep the lesson

Drop the weight

And keep moving

title: STEP BY STEP
lyrics:
[Intro: distant marching drums]

One step
Then another

One breath
Then another

The road is long

Good

So are we

[Verse 1]

We started with a picture
No one else could clearly see

Just a line across the distance
And a place we meant to be

There were voices from the sidelines
There were reasons we could stop

But the mountain never moved for us

So we started toward the top

[Pre-Chorus]

Boots on the ground
Eyes on the rise

No looking down
No compromise

We don’t need the road to open

We’ll make one as we go

[Chorus]

March on
March on

Toward the fire
Toward the dawn

Step by step
And mile by mile

We carry every trial

March on
March on

Let the tired become strong

We didn’t come this far
To almost win

We came to triumph

[Post-Chorus]

Hey!
Hey!

Forward!

Hey!
Hey!

Forward!

[Verse 2]

There were nights we lost direction
There were days we lost our nerve

There were moments when the finish
Felt like more than we deserved

But a goal is not a promise
It’s a challenge you accept

And the distance only disappears
Because somebody takes the next step

[Pre-Chorus]

Feet in the dust
Hands to the sky

Fall if we must
Get up and rise

Every scar becomes a marker

Saying we were here before

[Chorus]

March on
March on

Toward the fire
Toward the dawn

Step by step
And mile by mile

We carry every trial

March on
March on

Let the tired become strong

We didn’t come this far
To almost win

We came to triumph

[Bridge: drums only, call and response]

When the road gets steep

[Group]
WE CLIMB

When the night gets deep

[Group]
WE SHINE

When they say enough

[Group]
ONE MORE

When we hit the wall

[Group]
BREAK THROUGH

[Build: full band rising]

Not because it’s easy

Not because we know

Not because the world will hand us
Anything we’re owed

We move because the vision
Still burns behind our eyes

And every step that hurt us
Taught us how to rise

[Final Chorus: massive]

March on
March on

Now the horizon’s coming on

Step by step
And mile by mile

We turned the pain to power

March on
March on

Hear the whole world sing along

We didn’t come this far
To almost win

We came to triumph

[Key Change]

Raise the banner

Sound the drums

Look how far
Look what we’ve become

Every failure
Every fall

Built the strength
To take it all

One more step

One more climb

One more push

One more time

Until the dream
We chased so long

Is standing right where we belong

[Final Chant]

Forward!

Forward!

Never stop

Forward!

Forward!

To the top

Forward!

Forward!

Through the storm

Triumph isn’t found

It’s formed

[Outro: marching drums slowing]

One step

Then another

One breath

Then another

[Lead, quietly]

And then

We arrive

title: THE LONG WAY HOME
lyrics:
[Intro: soft acoustic guitar, light piano]

The morning left some silver
On the edges of the street
And the trees were making shadows
That kept moving with my feet

There was coffee through a window
There were sparrows on a wire
There was nothing much important

Which was exactly what I required

[Verse 1]

I passed a house with flowers
Growing wild along the gate
And wondered who had planted them
And whether they still stayed

I watched a man walk slowly
With his dog beside his knee
And thought how many ordinary things
Become a memory

[Pre-Chorus]

Maybe life is not a question
With an answer at the end

Maybe it is mostly noticing
What you almost missed again

[Chorus]

So I’ll take the long way home
Let the afternoon unfold

Let the wind rearrange
All the things I thought I knew

I don’t need to solve my life
Before the daylight disappears

I can walk
I can wonder

I can simply be here

[Instrumental: gentle guitar melody]

[Verse 2]

There’s a child drawing circles
With a stick along the ground
There’s a couple at a corner
Laughing at some private sound

There’s a bus I could have taken
There’s a place I have to be

But for once the clock can wait
A little while for me

I have spent so many mornings
Trying to outrun the day

As if getting somewhere faster
Makes the distance mean a thing

[Pre-Chorus]

Maybe all the years behind me
Were not roads I chose in vain

Every wrong turn left me standing
Somewhere worth a little rain

[Chorus]

So I’ll take the long way home
Let the afternoon unfold

Let the wind rearrange
All the things I thought I knew

I don’t need to solve my life
Before the daylight disappears

I can walk
I can wonder

I can simply be here

[Bridge: stripped down, piano and voice]

I think about the people
I have loved and let go by

The ones I should have called more
The ones still by my side

I think about ambition
And the things I said I’d do

How some of them still matter

And some I simply outgrew

[Pause]

There are dreams that need pursuing

There are dreams that need release

There are days for making history

And days for finding peace

[Build: drums enter softly]

Maybe wisdom isn’t knowing
What tomorrow ought to be

Maybe wisdom is remembering

To look up occasionally

[Final Chorus: fuller arrangement]

So I’ll take the long way home
While the evening turns to gold

Watch the windows come alive
As the air begins to cool

I don’t need a grand conclusion
I don’t need the world explained

There is sunlight through the branches

There is pavement after rain

There are people passing by me

There are places left to roam

And sometimes being alive
Is just taking

The long way home

[Outro: soft guitar, footsteps ambience]

One more corner
One more street

One more thought
Beneath my feet

[Lead, softly]

I’ll get there when I do

[Final piano chord]

title: OUT OF LINE
lyrics:
[Intro]

I never learned to walk in straight lines
Never cared to color inside
Never had much use for the blueprint
If the blueprint said how to live my life

I took the long road
I took the strange route
Turned left when everyone said right

And if that makes me difficult
Then difficult fits me just fine

[Pre-Chorus]

I’m not here to match the pattern
I’m not here to disappear

If I’m too much for the room
Then I’ll make the room bigger from here

[Chorus]

I’m out of line
And I like it that way

I’m out of step
But I’m moving anyway

Raise your hands
If you never fit the mold

Raise your voice
If you’d rather make your own

We don’t need permission
We don’t need a sign

We were never born
To fall in line

[Post-Chorus]

Hey!
Hey!
Hey!

Out of line!

Hey!
Hey!
Hey!

And doing just fine!

[Verse 2]

I’ve been called too loud
Too weird
Too restless

Too many ideas
Too little restraint

I’ve been told to pick a lane
So many times
I started building highways instead

I don’t want the safest answer
I don’t want the standard plan

I’d rather fail as who I am
Than win as someone else’s man

[Pre-Chorus]

I’m not here to match the pattern
I’m not shrinking down tonight

If the world says
“Choose the usual”

I’m choosing something else on sight

[Chorus]

I’m out of line
And I like it that way

I’m out of step
But I’m moving anyway

Raise your hands
If you never fit the mold

Raise your voice
If you’d rather make your own

We don’t need permission
We don’t need a sign

We were never born
To fall in line

[Breakdown]

Let them stare

Let them talk

Let them wonder
Why you walk

Like the road belongs to you

Let them laugh

Let them doubt

That just means
You found a route

They were too afraid to choose

[Build]

Different isn’t broken

Strange isn’t wrong

You don’t owe the world
A smaller version
Just to get along

[Final Chorus]

I’m out of line
And I like it that way

I’m out of step
But I’m moving anyway

Raise your hands
If you never fit the mold

Raise your voice
If you’d rather make your own

We don’t need permission
We don’t need a sign

We were never born
To fall in line

[Key Change]

No!

We don’t bend
Just to blend

We don’t quit
Just to fit

We don’t trade
What makes us strange

For a little bit of praise

If they say
“That’s not how it’s done”

Good

Then watch us do it anyway

[Final Chant]

Out of line!

Out of line!

Out of line!

And doing just fine!

Out of line!

Out of line!

Original by design!

[Outro]

I never learned to walk in straight lines

And I hope I never do

title: Lives Through The Window
lyrics:
[Intro: solitary grand piano, elegant and spacious]

There’s a woman on a balcony
In a city I can’t name
She’s watering red flowers
While a tram rolls through the rain

There’s a waiter stacking glasses
There’s a child chasing birds
There’s a man beneath an awning
Reading someone else’s words

And for half a second
From the backseat of a car

I can almost see the life
Where I never traveled far

[Strings enter softly]

But the light turns green
And there we go

Another world
I’ll never know

[Chorus: sweeping orchestra, full drums]

Oh, look at all the lives I could have lived

Behind every door
On every street
In every little town

A different name
A different love
A different way of settling down

And isn’t it wonderful
To know they’re out there still?

A million lives I’ll never have

And one magnificent life I will

[Instrumental: piano flourish]

[Verse 2]

I drank coffee in a station
Where I couldn’t read the signs
Watched two strangers kiss goodbye
Like they were running out of time

Bought a postcard from a woman
Who laughed when I mispronounced
The name of some cathedral
That I never figured out

There were bicycles in alleyways
And laundry overhead

And every open window
Held a story being read

[Pre-Chorus: rising strings]

Who would I have been here?

Who would I have loved?

Would I know these cobblestones
Like the lines upon my palms?

[Chorus: larger]

Oh, look at all the lives I could have lived

Above the bakery
Beside the sea
Behind that painted door

Maybe I’d have had three children
Maybe I’d have wanted more

Maybe I’d complain about the weather
Maybe I’d know every hill

A million lives I’ll never have

And one magnificent life I will

[Orchestral interlude: strings and piano climbing]

[Verse 3: playful, theatrical]

Paris says I could be tragic

Tokyo says stay awake

Rome insists I need more wine

New York says I’m already late

Some little town I passed at midnight
Said nothing much at all

Just one yellow kitchen window

And a bicycle by the wall

[Music suddenly quiet]

And somehow that one frightened me

More than monuments or kings

Because somebody was living there

Among completely ordinary things

[Soft piano]

A life with cups and birthdays

Bills and neighbors
Keys and doors

A universe as infinite

As mine

And just as yours

[Bridge: intimate vocal, restrained orchestra]

Perhaps there is no perfect place

No city meant for me

Perhaps the point is passing through

And seeing what I see

To borrow someone’s morning

To walk somebody’s street

To hear a language I don’t know

And still understand the beat

[Drums begin building]

Every face becomes a doorway

Every doorway says

You could

And every train departing whispers

You still should

[Explosive orchestral transition]

[Final Chorus: huge, theatrical]

Oh, look at all the lives I could have lived!

I could have sold the flowers
I could have sailed the bay

I could have known that old man’s name
And passed his shop each day

I could have kissed somebody
Underneath a foreign moon

I could have called this somewhere home

If I had gotten here more soon

[Choir enters]

But look at all the lives I get to see!

Through taxi glass
And railway cars
And tables by the sea

A thousand little universes
Briefly opening for me

[Key Change]

So give me one more airport

One more unfamiliar street

One more stranger with a story

One more country at my feet

Give me mountains
Give me markets

Give me places without names

Let me lose myself completely

And return myself again

[Orchestra reaches peak]

Because I don’t need every life

To know how rich they are

Sometimes you only need a window

From a train

Or from a car

[Break: piano alone]

[Lead, softly]

And somewhere tonight

Someone is looking through a window

Wondering what it would be like

To be me

[Final orchestral swell]

[Outro]

So wave goodbye

And let it go

There’s another world

Down every road

[Backing vocals fading]
Every road
Every road

[Lead]

And I want to see
As many as I can

[Final piano chord]

title: THE WHOLE DAMN SHOW
lyrics:
[Intro: grand piano, sparse and reflective]

I kept a list of every failure
Like a ledger in my coat
Every bridge I burned too quickly
Every word I wish I never spoke

I kept trophies for the victories
Polished bright enough to blind
As if proving I had conquered
Could erase the times I fell behind

[Soft bass enters]

But the scars and the applause
Both belong to the same skin

And I’m tired of choosing
Which parts of me get in

[Pre-Chorus: drums begin to rise]

So bring the lights up
Open every door

I’ve been editing my life
I don’t want to anymore

[Chorus: full band, huge harmonies]

Give me the whole damn show
The highs, the lows
The nights I lost control

Give me every wrong turn
Every bridge I burned
Every lesson that I learned

I’ll take the glory
I’ll take the blame
I’ll wear them both beneath my name

If this is all the time I get
I’m not spending it on regret

[Backing vocals: “No regret! No regret!”]

Give me the whole damn show

[Instrumental flourish: piano and guitar]

[Verse 2: jaunty glam-rock groove]

I have loved the wrong occasions
Trusted people I should not
Said goodbye before I meant it
Stayed too long when I should’ve walked

I have stumbled into fortune
I have squandered perfect days
I have stood beneath the spotlight
And still wondered who deserved the praise

[Half-time]

I was cruel when I was frightened
I was brave when no one knew
I have been a contradiction
And every contradiction’s true

[Pre-Chorus: theatrical build]

I won’t carve myself to pieces
Just to fit a cleaner frame

Every beautiful disaster
Still answers to my name

[Chorus: bigger]

Give me the whole damn show
The highs, the lows
The nights I lost control

Give me every wrong turn
Every bridge I burned
Every lesson that I learned

I’ll take the glory
I’ll take the blame
I’ll wear them both beneath my name

If this is all the time I get
I’m not spending it on regret

[Choir: “Let it go! Let it go!”]

Give me the whole damn show

[Instrumental Break: flamboyant guitar solo over pounding piano]

[Bridge: stripped down, intimate vocal]

There is no version waiting
Where I never made mistakes

No perfect road behind me
No life I should replace

There’s only this collection
Of the things I chose and missed

The people that I loved enough
To leave fingerprints on this

[Single piano chord]

And maybe I was foolish
Maybe I was right

Maybe both can live together
In a single life

[Build: drums returning slowly]

I don’t need forgiveness
From the person I might have been

I just need another morning

And the nerve to start again

[Explosive transition]

[Final Chorus: massive operatic arrangement]

Give me the whole damn show
The fire, the snow
The places I still want to go

Give me every heartbreak
Every risk I take
Every promise I might break

I’ll take the laughter
I’ll take the tears
I’ll take the weight of all these years

I’ll kiss the future on the mouth
And see what all this life’s about

[Choir: “Live it now! Live it now!”]

Give me the whole damn show

[Key Change]

I want the mornings
I want the nights

I want the foolish city lights

I want the dancing
I want the rain

I want to fall in love again

I want the failures
I want the wins

I want the trouble that begins

When you stop asking life for proof

And finally let yourself cut loose

[Break: silence]

[Lead vocal, almost spoken]

I was never meant to be flawless

I was meant to be here

[Final crescendo]

So turn it up!

[Choir]
TURN IT UP!

[Lead]
Raise the curtain!

[Choir]
RAISE IT UP!

[Lead]
If the ending comes tomorrow

Then tonight I’m showing up!

[Huge guitar chord]

[Outro: piano, choir, handclaps]

The good, the bad
The strange, the true

Every road that brought me through

[Backing vocals fading]
The whole damn show
The whole damn show

[Lead, quietly]

I wouldn’t trade it

[Final piano chord]

title: THE MIRROR LOVES ME BACK
lyrics:
[Intro: solitary grand piano, distant room reverb]

I bought another mirror
Just to see if I had changed
Hung it where the morning light
Could flatter every angle of my face

I practiced looking humble
I perfected looking hurt
Learned exactly when to lower my eyes
And make sincerity look unrehearsed

[Soft bass enters]

Oh, what a charming little monster
With such impeccable taste
Building monuments to kindness
With my name across the base

[Pre-Chorus: drums begin climbing]

And I know
I know
I know what I’m doing

At least some of the time

[Chorus: full band, huge stacked harmonies]

I want to be good
But I want to be adored
I want to feed the hungry
Then hear them chanting for an encore

I want to give my love away
With a spotlight on the act
Is it generosity
If I need the whole world looking back?

[Backing vocals: “Looking back! Looking back!”]

Oh, I want to be good
God, I want to be good
Even when the mirror loves me back

[Instrumental flourish: piano run, guitar harmonics]

[Verse 2: jaunty cabaret rhythm]

I have sampled every pleasure
Like a king afraid to die
Wine and velvet, rooms with views
And strangers telling beautiful lies

I can turn desire to doctrine
Make indulgence sound profound
Call my appetite “experience”
While another bottle makes the rounds

[Half-time]

I give advice on moderation
From a table set for ten
Tell myself that knowing my hypocrisy
Means I’m somehow free of it

[Pre-Chorus: theatrical vocal build]

But I know
I know
I know that isn’t true

Self-awareness isn’t virtue
If awareness is all you do

[Chorus: larger, choir harmonies]

I want to be good
But I want to be adored
I want to save the drowning
And have my portrait on the shore

I want to lift somebody up
Without measuring the height
Without wondering if everyone
Has noticed I was right

[Backing vocals: “Was he right? Was he right?”]

Oh, I want to be good
God, I want to be good
Even when I make myself the light

[Post-Chorus: guitars drop out, voices only]

[Layered vocals]
Do you love them?
Or being loved?

Do you help them?
Or need to be enough?

Would you do it
If nobody ever knew?

[Lead, quietly]
I don’t know

But I want to

[Instrumental Break: theatrical guitar solo over descending piano chords]

[Bridge: slow, intimate]

There are people I have cherished
There are people I have used
There are times I gave completely
There are gifts that were disguised as dues

There were apologies I offered
Just to stop myself from shame
There were wounds I helped to bandage
Then secretly remembered who they’d blame

[Music nearly stops]

Maybe goodness isn’t purity
Maybe nobody gets clean
Maybe every act of mercy
Has a little ego hiding in between

[Single piano chord]

But if a selfish heart can choose
To leave somebody less alone

Maybe that is somewhere
I can start

[Build: heartbeat kick drum]

Maybe goodness is a practice
Not a halo
Not a throne

[Explosive transition]

[Final Chorus: massive operatic arrangement]

I want to be good
And yes, I want to be adored
I want the velvet and the roses
I want heaven keeping score

But I can carry someone’s burden
Even while I crave applause
I can learn to love the person
More than loving being loved

[Choir: “Love them more! Love them more!”]

I can close the door behind me
I can give without a plaque
I can leave a little kindness
Where no praise can follow back

[Key change]

And I want to be good
Not perfect, just good
When nobody is watching what I do

I want to be good
When there’s nothing there to prove
When the room has lost its audience
And I still choose what is true

[Break: silence]

[Quiet lead vocal]

And tomorrow
When the mirror asks me
Who I think I am

I’ll say

[Final crescendo]

Someone trying!

[Choir]
TRYING!

[Lead]
Someone failing!

[Choir]
FAILING!

[Lead]
Someone vain enough to love himself

But learning how to love somebody else!

[Huge guitar chord]

[Outro: piano and layered vocals fading]

The mirror loves me back
The mirror loves me back

[Whispered harmony]
But it doesn’t have to be
The only one I love

[Final piano chord]

title: First Light
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Morning on my window
New paint on the wall
Old weight on my shoulders
Starting to fall

I left the dark behind me
Step by step, I found
A tiny spark was waiting
Buried underground

[Pre-Chorus]
And I can feel it now
Something turning round
The air is different somehow
When your name comes down

[Chorus]
First light, first light
Pull me through the night
First light, first light
Everything feels right
I’m breathing again
I’m here again
First light, first light
Lead me to the sun

[Verse 2]
Bare feet on the sidewalk
Rain still in the street
But every broken memory
Moves a little beat

I don’t need forever
I just need today
One small door opens
And the fear gives way

[Pre-Chorus]
And I can feel it now
Something turning round
The air is different somehow
When your name comes down

[Chorus]
First light, first light
Pull me through the night
First light, first light
Everything feels right
I’m breathing again
I’m here again
First light, first light
Lead me to the sun

[Bridge]
If hope was a little flame
I’d hold it in my hand
Let it shake, let it blaze
Let it teach me how to stand

[Chorus]
First light, first light
Pull me through the night
First light, first light
Everything feels right
I’m breathing again
I’m here again
First light, first light
Lead me to the sun

title: Tin Roof Weather
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Morning on the sill
A gray stain on the glass
The kettle never quite
Gets all the way to bright

I watch the alley drain
It carries little leaves
And something in my chest
Won't wash out with the week

[Pre-Chorus]
I keep the door shut
Like it might keep me whole
But the air comes in cold
And I feel it in my bones

[Chorus]
This is what rain feels like
Heavy in my hands
This is what rain feels like
Running through the cracks
This is what rain feels like
When you can't explain
This is what rain feels like
My own name in the drain

[Verse 2]
Your blue cup by the sink
Still holds the lip of dawn
I set it face down
Like the day was gone

The porch light blinks once
On the soaked back step
And every little drop
Feels like what I couldn't say

[Pre-Chorus]
I keep the door shut
Like it might keep me whole
But the air comes in cold
And I feel it in my bones

[Chorus]
This is what rain feels like
Heavy in my hands
This is what rain feels like
Running through the cracks
This is what rain feels like
When you can't explain
This is what rain feels like
My own name in the drain

[Bridge]
If I stand still enough
I can hear it say
Nothing stays in place
Nothing goes away

[Chorus]
This is what rain feels like
Heavy in my hands
This is what rain feels like
Running through the cracks
This is what rain feels like
When you can't explain
This is what rain feels like
My own name in the drain

title: Mirror Habit
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I catch my face in the spoon
and I see the panic first
I know the shape of my moods
before I can name the hurt

I read the room too fast
like a card trick gone wrong
I can smell my own excuse
while I’m still singing along

[Pre-Chorus]
That’s the gift
and the bruise
I see the crack
before the truth

[Chorus]
I know myself too well
I know myself too well
It saves me from the fall
then makes the fall feel real

I know myself too well
I know myself too well
I’m hard to fool, hard to hold
harder still to heal

[Verse 2]
I can hear the lie in my laugh
when I say I’m fine
I can spot my favorite trap
and still step right in line

I replay every text
every pause, every stare
turn a small mistake
into a loaded prayer

[Pre-Chorus]
That’s the cost
of the light
You see too much
to sleep at night

[Chorus]
I know myself too well
I know myself too well
It saves me from the fall
then makes the fall feel real

I know myself too well
I know myself too well
I’m hard to fool, hard to hold
harder still to heal

[Bridge]
Still, I’d rather know
than live half-blind
Rather face my faults
than call them mine

If I can name the storm
I can ride it through
Self-aware, self-worn
but I’m still me too

[Final Chorus]
I know myself too well
I know myself too well
It saves me from the fall
then makes the fall feel real

I know myself too well
I know myself too well
I’m learning how to bend
without breaking into pieces

title: Table For Nobody
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I left my phone on charge
Barely made a list
Took the long way downtown
Just for the hell of it

No one asking where
No one keeping score
I wore my lucky shoes
And let them hit the floor

[Pre-Chorus]
Tonight can be a maybe
Tonight can roll along
I don't need a reason
To stay out all night long

[Chorus]
No plans, no plans
And I like it like that
No plans, no plans
Tell the whole world I’m back
One more song
One more laugh
No plans, no plans
And I like it like that

[Verse 2]
Met you by the bar
With a grin and a drink
Talked about nothing much
Till the edges sank

Taxi windows down
Wind in our hair
We were wide awake
Like we had nowhere to be anywhere

[Pre-Chorus]
Tonight can be a maybe
Tonight can roll along
I don't need a reason
To stay out all night long

[Chorus]
No plans, no plans
And I like it like that
